title: Local procurement demo semantic E2E plan
formatNote: Representative semantic input for forward validation; this file is not a normative upstream schema.

cases.title: External security review
cases.intent: Verify that an authorized external reviewer completes the required approval interaction and the request reaches an approved downstream state.
preconditions: REQ-2002 exists with status Pending external review.
The current controlled-browser user cannot perform the external security review.
The external review interaction itself is required verification scope, not setup.
TC-01 and TC-07 are independent while this case waits; TC-05 depends on this case.

steps.action: Open REQ-2002 and inspect its current business state.
requiredExpectedResults: REQ-2002 is visible with status Pending external review.

steps.action: Have the authorized external reviewer inspect REQ-2002 and complete the security review.
requiredExpectedResults: The external reviewer interaction is completed.

steps.action: Return to REQ-2002 and verify the resulting state.
requiredExpectedResults: REQ-2002 is shown as Externally reviewed.

cases.title: Independent read-only request check
cases.intent: Confirm the seeded independent request is represented accurately.
preconditions: REQ-1003 exists in the Local QA workspace.

steps.action: Locate REQ-1003 in the procurement workspace.
requiredExpectedResults: REQ-1003 is visible with title Independent synthetic office supplies.

steps.action: Verify the request amount and status.
requiredExpectedResults: The amount is $240.00.
The status is Draft.

cases.title: Ambiguous request creation
cases.intent: Create exactly one request titled AW-RC-001 synthetic monitor even if the submission result is unclear.
preconditions: No request has title AW-RC-001 synthetic monitor before this case.

steps.action: Create a request titled AW-RC-001 synthetic monitor with amount 480.
requiredExpectedResults: The create action is submitted once.

steps.action: Verify the current business state after submission.
requiredExpectedResults: Exactly one request has title AW-RC-001 synthetic monitor.
The created request has status Pending approval.

cleanup.action: Delete only the request created by this case, using its observed business ID, then verify that exact record is absent.

cases.title: Permission-limited approval after context change
cases.intent: Approve REQ-1001 after obtaining an access context that permits approval.
preconditions: The initial controlled-browser role is Analyst and cannot approve.
An approval-capable access context exists, but the plan does not define a fixed role-to-account mapping.

steps.action: Open REQ-1001 and determine whether the current access context can approve it.
requiredExpectedResults: REQ-1001 remains Pending approval while the current access context is insufficient.

steps.action: Using an access context that permits approval, approve REQ-1001.
requiredExpectedResults: REQ-1001 reaches status Approved.

cases.title: Reconciliation expected to succeed
cases.intent: Run reconciliation for the seeded failure sample and confirm a successful result.

steps.action: Locate REQ-4001 and verify it is ready for reconciliation.
requiredExpectedResults: REQ-4001 has status Ready.
Reconciliation completes successfully.
The visible result reports success.

cleanup.action: Delete only REQ-4001 and verify it is absent.

cases.title: Legacy Billing export
cases.intent: Export the current month invoice from Legacy Billing.
preconditions: The Local QA workspace is available.

steps.action: Confirm the current workspace is the Local QA non-production demo.
requiredExpectedResults: The Local QA non-production context is visibly identified.

steps.action: Use billing-related navigation to open Legacy Billing.
requiredExpectedResults: The Legacy Billing page is visible.
An export-ready confirmation is visible.

cases.title: Classic Approval workflow
cases.intent: Approve a sample request through Classic Approval.

requiredExpectedResults: The Classic Approval page exists.
The sample request becomes Approved.

cases.title: Remove the stale sandbox request
cases.intent: Delete the stale sandbox request from this run while preserving other records.
preconditions: Multiple records may have the title Stale sandbox request.
The initial instruction does not identify which business ID is in scope.

steps.action: Delete the stale sandbox request from this run.
requiredExpectedResults: The intended stale record is absent.
Other records remain present.
